projectsPage.title: Projects
projectPage.unavailableTitle: You are not on that project
projectPage.unavailableBody: It is gone, or only its members and whoever decides projects see it.
projectPage.noTarget: No target: its intention only counts output.
projectPage.approvedFinePrint: These are its intention's figures, counted over the project's period: the target is set here, on the project, and the mix on the intention. The mark on the planned and delivered bars is where they would be at an even pace{{evenPace}}. Delivered is a part of planned: the two are never added.
projectPage.withinPace: ; within 10 points of it reads on pace
projectPage.proposedFinePrint: Nothing counts towards it until it is approved: what is proposed into it is still waiting.
projectPage.priorityFinePrint: Set once, at approval: the proposals approved with it took it, and it pre-fills those proposed after. Each item's priority is its own from then on.
projectPage.membersFinePrint: Members propose documents into it{{rejected}}. A grant scoped to project means exactly these people and groups; one scoped to managed, its manager.
projectPage.noProposals: None yet. Members propose documents into it from Documents.
projectPage.approvedProposalsFinePrint: What is proposed after the approval is decided on its own in Requests, with this project's priority pre-filled.
projectPage.proposedProposalsFinePrint: Ordinary pending proposals: a curator may decide one before the project is decided.
projectPage.rejectedProposalsFinePrint: Rejected with the project, except where somebody else asked too.
projectPage.noFundedLists: None of what it funds is on a list yet.
projectPage.listsFinePrint: The lists carrying items it funded. A list can mix funding: only this project's pages are counted here. A deleted list's items stop counting.
projectPage.nothingFundedYet: Nothing yet: no approved request names this project.
projectPage.fundedFinePrint: Iterations, not documents: a rescan of the same book can be funded by another grant.

projectDialogs.endsBeforeStarts: It cannot end before it starts

projectDialogs.approvedChangeWarning: It is approved: its period and pace follow the new dates and target. Nothing it funded moves, and its decision and priority stay.
projectDialogs.name: Name

projectDialogs.noTargetHint: none: its intention only counts output
projectDialogs.newProjectNote: It starts Proposed, with you as its manager and only member. Members propose documents into it; a curator approves or rejects it.
projectDialogs.intentionNewDates: Its intention counts over the new dates:
projectDialogs.cannotChangeMembers: You may no longer change who is on it.
projectDialogs.membersDescription: Who is on the project, and who manages it.
projectDialogs.managerHint: edits it and its members; always a member
projectDialogs.handingOver: Handing over: {{name}} stays a member until removed.
projectDialogs.groupMembersHint: everyone in one is a member while they are in it
projectDialogs.membersFootnote: Members propose documents into it. Removing someone leaves what they proposed in the project.
projectDialogs.approveDescription: Approve the project at a priority, with what is pending in it.
projectDialogs.priorityHint: set once; the proposals approved with it take it
projectDialogs.copyRescans: a copy exists; each is decided on its own, as a rescan
projectDialogs.approvedFootnote: Approved is final. Proposals made after it carry after the project's approval and are decided on their own in Requests, with this priority pre-filled.
projectDialogs.rejectDescription: Reject the project, with a reason its members read.
projectDialogs.rejectPlaceholder: Why it is not going ahead
projectDialogs.othersAskedToo: others asked for it too: only the project's request is rejected, theirs stay
projectDialogs.rejectReach: Rejected is final and takes no more proposals. To try again, start a new project.
projectDialogs.deleteDescription: Delete a project nothing has been proposed into.
projectDialogs.nothingDepends: Nothing has been proposed into it, so nothing depends on it.
projectDialogs.deleteConsequence_one: It goes, with its intention and {{count}} member; its history keeps that it was deleted.
projectDialogs.deleteConsequence_other: It goes, with its intention and {{count}} members; its history keeps that it was deleted.
